name: MapAction
meaning: g_map.actionIndex (+0x40): the four buttons, matching the icon pairs loaded in Map_InitObject (IGLHELPA/B, IGLUSEDA/B, IGLCOMBA/B, IGLEXITA/B).

name: MAP_ACT_USE
meaning: Inventory select + Wolf_SwapHeldItem(g_pWolf,0,1) then close the map - this is the withdraw/equip path

name: MAP_ACT_COMBINE
meaning: Map_CombineItems, or Map_SplitItem when the selected class carries SCN_CF_COMPOSITE_ITEM
